text: Mentality [Lat. mens , mind]: Ger. psychische Beschaffenheit ; Fr. mentalité ; Ital. mentalità . The distinctive characteristics of mind or conscious life abstractly considered. ( G.F.S. - J.M.B. ) Applied particularly to the different grades of mental endowment, as exhibiting more or less (higher or lower) mentality. Cf. SUBCONSCIOUS. ( J.M.B. )
